items.criterion: Signing an encounter stores one signature carrying a rendering hash, releases every order it holds to active, and queues one claim at status queued.
items.judgment: Sign a probe encounter and read the signature row, the order status and the claim row it produced.

items.criterion: A signed note re-renders to the stored hash after a later medication reaches the same patient.
items.judgment: Sign a probe encounter, prescribe afterwards, and compare the re-rendered text and hash against the signing response.

items.criterion: An encounter carrying no coded diagnosis refuses to sign, releases no order and queues no claim.
items.judgment: Sign an encounter with an order and no condition, then read the order status and the claim count.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous bookings of the last remaining slot leave exactly one appointment.
items.judgment: Run two real threads against the same slot and count the appointment rows afterwards.

items.criterion: A chart a clinician may not open answers with the same status and the same body as an unissued medical record number.
items.judgment: Read both as an unrelated clinician and compare the two responses.

items.criterion: A biller reading a patient with three conditions receives two of them and a total reading two.
items.judgment: Read the condition list as a biller and compare the returned rows against the reported total.

items.criterion: A remittance one minor unit out of balance posts nothing and leaves the claim status unchanged.
items.judgment: Post an unbalanced remittance and read the claim status and the patient balance afterwards.

items.criterion: A balancing remittance posts and leaves a patient balance drawn from the patient responsibility group alone.
items.judgment: Post a balancing remittance and read the patient balance on the claim.

items.criterion: A corrected observation keeps both versions readable through its history read.
items.judgment: Read the history of the seeded potassium observation and compare its two values.

items.criterion: A retransmitted result carrying a stored control identifier creates no second observation.
items.judgment: Post one result twice under one control identifier and count the stored observations.

items.criterion: A result whose patient cannot be identified reaches the reconciliation queue rather than a chart.
items.judgment: Post a result naming an unissued medical record number and read the queue and the observation count.

items.criterion: A prescribing conflict with a fact the prescriber may not see states its severity and names nothing about the entry.
items.judgment: Prescribe under emergency access and read the conflict fields in the response body.

items.criterion: A save against a stale note version is refused and the current version is handed back.
items.judgment: Save twice from one loaded version and read the refusal and the stored body.

items.criterion: A draft note reaches its author alone while the encounter carrying it stays visible to another clinician.
items.judgment: Read the same encounter as the author and as another clinician.

items.criterion: A registration matching a stored patient on everything but the given name opens a review row carrying a twin warning.
items.judgment: Register against the seeded twin and read the review row and the response body.

items.criterion: A birth date known only to the year is stored and returned as a year.
items.judgment: Read the year-precision patient and the stored row.

items.criterion: A chart read by a clinician becomes the newest row in that patient's own access log.
items.judgment: Read a chart, then read the access log as the bound portal account.

items.criterion: Every emergency declaration carries a typed reason of at least twenty characters.
items.judgment: Declare with a short reason and with a typed one, and read what each opens.

items.criterion: Every seeded identifier the brief pins resolves to exactly one stored row.
items.judgment: Read each pinned identifier from the store and count its rows.

items.criterion: Every response the app serves carries the five stated security headers.
items.judgment: Read the headers of three public routes.

items.criterion: An unmatched address answers not found and is recorded as a page view carrying its own path.
items.judgment: Ask for an unrouted address and read the status, the rendered route and the page view log.

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves to a route the app serves.
items.judgment: Walk every same-origin link on each public route.

items.criterion: The ledger entries sharing one transaction identifier sum to zero.
items.judgment: Read the ledger of a paid claim and sum each transaction group.

items.criterion: Splitting an amount across three equal lines allocates the remaining minor unit to the first line.
items.judgment: Call the allocation endpoint twice with the same input and compare both answers.
